description_zh: 查询视频理解任务结果
kebab_example: aliyun ice query-video-cognition-job --job-id 000020b48fb04483915d4f2cd8ac0000 --params '{}' --include-results NeedOcr=true NeedAsr=true NeedProcess=true --region cn-hangzhou
name: QueryVideoCognitionJob

parameters.help_en: The ID of the intelligent tagging job. You can obtain this ID from the response of the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/478786.html operation
parameters.help_zh: 需要查询的智能标签作业ID。可以从https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/478786.html的返回参数中获取
parameters.name: job_id

parameters.help_en: Additional request parameters, specified as a JSON string
parameters.help_zh: 额外的请求参数，使用 JSON 字符串表示
parameters.name: params

fields.help_en: Specifies whether to return the ASR results
fields.name: need_asr

fields.help_en: Specifies whether to return the OCR results
fields.name: need_ocr

fields.help_en: Specifies whether to return a link to the raw operator results
fields.help_zh: 是否显示算子原始结果链接
fields.name: need_process

parameters.help_en: A container for parameters that determine which algorithm results to include in the response
parameters.help_zh: 查询结果中是否包含完整算法结果
parameters.name: include_results

JobStatus.description_en:
The job status. Valid values:

Success: The job succeeded.

Fail: The job failed.

Processing: The job is in progress.

Submitted: The job has been submitted and is awaiting processing
JobStatus.description_zh:
任务状态，可取值：

Success：处理成功。

Fail：处理失败。

Processing：处理中。

Submitted：已提交等待处理

result.description_en: An array of analysis result objects

Data.description_en: The analysis result data, formatted as a JSON string. The data structure varies based on the Type value. For more information, see the descriptions of the Result parameter
Data.description_zh: 分析结果的具体数据，以JSON字符串表示。不同Type的数据结构见下文Result参数说明

Type.description_en:
The type of the analysis result. Valid values:

TextLabel: text label

VideoLabel: video label

ASR: raw ASR result (not returned by default)

OCR: raw OCR result (not returned by default)

NLP: raw NLP result (not returned by default)

Process: URL to the raw operator result (not returned by default)
Type.description_zh:
分析结果的类型。

TextLabel：文本标签
VideoLabel：视频标签
ASR：语音识别原始结果（默认不返回）
OCR：文字识别原始结果（默认不返回）
NLP：NLP处理结果（默认不返回）
Process：算子原始结果链接（默认不返回）
